changelog: New: the fullscreen listening room is free for everyone, with 9 lyric styles: Classic, Pop, Focus, Neon, Wheel, Fisheye, Chat, Code and Branches.
New for Pro: 7 more lyric styles (Constellation, Bounce, Warp, Poster, Echo, Pulse and Rain), plus the Ring, Mirror and Particles visualizers and Edge Light in the listening room.
Lyrics follow the song more closely: word-by-word timing for more songs, an allowance for Bluetooth headphone delay, and the sync you set is remembered for each song.
New: Settings, General, Performance. Choose Battery saver, Balanced (the default), Best, or Auto, which switches to Battery saver on battery below 30%.
Clipboard: clips are grouped by day, the arrow keys and Enter pick a clip from search, and a button takes you back to the newest clip.
Fixed: alerts on the closed notch no longer block clicks on the browser tabs or page below them.
Fixed: Smart Notch no longer asks to send a crash report after Windows closed it while signing out or shutting down.

highlight.title: Meet the listening room for everyone
highlight.text: The fullscreen listening room is now free, with 9 lyric styles like Chat, Code and Fisheye. Pro adds 7 more, including Constellation, Rain and Pulse. Play a song, open the notch's music tab and choose Fullscreen.
